title: Hashimoto vs. Ogawa: the ace under siege
summary: Judo star Naoya Ogawa challenges Shinya Hashimoto’s status as New Japan’s ace. Their confrontations blur the presentation of wrestling and fighting, ending this chapter with Hashimoto’s career at stake.

chapters.title: Ogawa defeats the ace
chapters.result: Ogawa defeats Hashimoto by referee decision.
chapters.context: The newcomer’s victory creates a direct threat to the established champion’s credibility, beginning a rivalry with consequences beyond the title picture.

chapters.title: Hashimoto loses the career-stakes confrontation
chapters.context: Hashimoto had put retirement on the line. The loss closes this chapter, but the stipulation should not be mistaken for the permanent end of his wrestling career.
